panel_findings.statement: In LixiLan-L, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin (+ metformin +- OADs), LS mean change in body weight from baseline with Insulin glargine 100 units/mL (n=365) was +0.7 +- 0.2 kg.
In LixiLan-L, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin (+ metformin +- OADs), LS mean change in body weight from baseline with SOLIQUA (n=366) was -0.7 +- 0.2 kg.
In LixiLan-L, the difference in LS mean change in body weight from baseline between SOLIQUA and Insulin glargine 100 units/mL had p < 0.0001.
In SoliMix, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin + OADs after 26 weeks, change in weight from baseline with Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 (n=444) was +1.2 +- 0.2 kg.
In SoliMix, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin + OADs after 26 weeks, change in weight from baseline with SOLIQUA (n=443) was -0.7 +- 0.2 kg.
In SoliMix, the difference in weight change between SOLIQUA and Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 had p < 0.0001 after 26 weeks.

In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulins, mean change from baseline in body weight with Basal bolus therapy (n=195) was +0.70 +- 0.24 kg.

In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulins, mean change from baseline in body weight with SOLIQUA (n=195) was -0.62 +- 0.24 kg.
In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), the difference in mean change from baseline in body weight between SOLIQUA and Basal bolus therapy had p < 0.0001.
